To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
we have implemented a semantic SDN-based network management system called EasyWay that can automatically manage enterprise networks with high level abstractions.
we have designed and implemented a new SDN-based management system for enterprise network that simplifies and automates network management.

(1) EasyWay provides a new approach to enterprise network management that simplifies and automates the management process by introducing high level abstractions and by using SDN/OpenFlow technology; (2) EasyWay is the first network management system that uses SDN/OpenFlow in enterprise networks and provides high level abstractions for managing networks; (3) EasyWay can be used for network management tasks that were not possible to do in traditional networks (e.g., dynamic reconfiguration of network paths);
